normal.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: attached Winamp Classic application screenshot. Faithfully remaster its raster graphics at 4x resolution. Preserve the exact original Winamp 2.x design, proportions, navy-gray palette, thin gold title rails, silver-blue beveled buttons, pixel-style labels and green LCD. Keep ALL three panels and every control in its exact normalized position; output aspect ratio 275:428, with no added border, no layout changes. Make edges, bevels, icons and slider handles clean and precise, with subtle dimensional shading rather than blurry enlarged pixels. No rounded modern controls, no redesign. This will be a production skin for the existing app, whose logical size must remain 275 x 428. Clear dynamic content to solid black: timer, spectrum, song-title field, bitrate/sample-rate numeric fields, playlist tracks, bottom status/time fields. Keep all permanent labels and transport symbols. Keep EQ slider handles at center. Output one clean high-resolution skin image, no watermark.

pressed.prompt: Edit this compact Winamp HD button sprite sheet. Keep the EXACT same 6-column, 4-row grid, canvas dimensions, control rectangles, positions, symbols and labels. Change ONLY the 24 individual buttons/handles from raised to visibly PRESSED, in the original Winamp 2.x style: recessed darker silver faces, deep inner top and left shadows, reversed bevels with bright lower/right edges, sunken symbols shifted slightly down/right. Clearly dimensional mechanical pressed buttons, same HD quality. Flat navy background stays identical. Keep each button inside its existing rectangle. No rearrangement, no new labels, no panel or interface around them. Return the same aligned sheet, every button depressed.
pressed.status: Generated successfully with built-in image_gen; mapped to all 24 controls.
